Chapter 1414 - 1: Information From A Past Timeline_2

Chapter 1414: Chapter 1: Information from a Past Timeline_2

Lin Yuan pondered in his mind.

Of course, now he is essentially no different from a lord, perhaps even surpassing ordinary lords.

But ultimately, he is not yet a lord, having not experienced the realm transcendence or the essence of life transcendence post-becoming a lord.

"Once the ’Three World Method’ is mastered, it can almost be said to guarantee becoming a lord."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Once the past self, present self, and future self are gathered, even without doing anything, under the instinctive operation of the three selves, multiple timelines will naturally align and converge.

"However, mastering the ’Three World Method’ is far more difficult than becoming a lord."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Not to mention the most challenging future self, even just the past self, was more difficult to gather than becoming a lord. Lin Yuan awakened the ninth type of Physical Body Divine Ability by utilizing the fundamental power deep in his bloodline and observing the operation of the illusory world before gathering it.

Thereafter, by using the past and present selves to anchor the future self and the Three-Life Immortal Emperor’s teachings of the Three World Method, he finally managed to gather the future self.

Even for Lin Yuan, mastering the ’Three World Method’ was so challenging. Other Second Realm time beings can’t even think about it, and even among Third Realm time lords, those who have mastered it are very rare.

Otherwise, given the ’Three World Method’s advantage in exploring the ’infinite origin,’ the other two Immortal Emperors of the Great Wilderness Origin World should have mastered it early on.

In reality, neither Dao You Immortal Emperor nor Emperor Wu Yu have mastered the ’Three World Method.’

"Three-Life Immortal Emperor actually passed on such a precious secret technique to me without reservation."

Lin Yuan felt somewhat emotional; even if other lords could not master it, this secret technique inheritance could enhance one’s ability to explore the ’infinite origin,’ leaving no doubt about its preciousness.

"Since it is possible to step into the Third Realm after fifty thousand or hundred thousand years, now is the time to consider matters post-becoming a lord."

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn.

Gray Ancestor is only a Second Realm time being, yet he is attempting to plan for Third Realm lord-tier materials, the Heart of Heavenly River, to prepare for his future.

Let alone Lin Yuan?

Compared to the First Realm, Second Realm, time lords in the Third Realm have so much to accomplish, and besides becoming a Perfect Time Being, the other two paths are extremely time-consuming.

Endless tribulations require crossing tens of billions of tribulations, and the infinite origin is even without an end.

Lin Yuan does not plan to attempt becoming a Perfect Time Being; it’s too risky, failure means death.

Thus, he is destined to remain at the time lord stage for an extended period.

"Since I plan to attempt the endless tribulations, I must improve my power as much as possible."

Lin Yuan thought inwardly.

The path of endless tribulations requires passing various tests set by Supreme Rule Dao awareness.

According to the Three-Life Immortal Emperor, each lord faces different tribulation tests, and even the same tribulation stage presents different tests.

As for the test content, it’s even stranger, some tests require traveling to special places to kill a life form, and some require going to the past time-space to prevent certain events from happening.

Therefore, to pass the tests, strength must be sustained.

Because most tests are related to strength.

The stronger the strength, the higher the possibility of overcoming tribulations.

And enhancing strength... the simplest means is through weapons.

Before the Second Realm, Lin Yuan had hardly used weapons, relying instead on sheer power.

But upon reaching the Third Realm, facing time lords with unpredictable abilities, strong weapons are needed.

"Origin Clock."

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and a palm-sized ancient clock floated above his palm.

This is the natal weapon Lin Yuan refined during his weaker days, and since becoming a time being, he has re-refined the Origin Clock several times, allowing it to also evolve to the thirteenth tier level.

However, to reach a level useful to Lin Yuan, it must at least be a lord-tier weapon.

"Lord-tier..."

Lin Yuan looked at the Origin Clock in his palm, "I need a large amount of Third Realm lord-grade materials."

The previously acquired lord-grade material, the Heart of Heavenly River, is far from sufficient to fulfill the Origin Clock’s evolution to Third Realm needs, so Lin Yuan still needs to collect a large amount of lord-tier materials.

The Origin Clock, being Lin Yuan’s natal weapon, can provide him far more help than other lord-tier weapons if it evolves to lord-grade.

Even if the Origin Clock only evolves to the Second Realm, it wouldn’t be weaker than ordinary lord-grade weapons.

"Besides normally collecting, I can also trade with other lords."

Lin Yuan thought to himself; even time lords have needs and will engage in numerous transactions.

Of course, to secure lord-grade materials through trade, corresponding tier treasures must be exchanged.

...

Chaos Qi drifted around.

Lord Mo Xu looked at the newly ascended time being, Luo Hou: "How stable is the realm?"

"Almost there." Luo Hou nodded.

As a newly ascended time being, the first thing to do is to stabilize the realm and adapt to the new power.

The leap from the Twelfth Layer to the Thirteenth Layer is the transition from a non-time being to a time being; the perspective of the latter is completely different from the former.

"That works."

Lord Mo Xu smiled and said, "I’ll take you to see the Galaxy and see if we can let you enter the Milky Way dimension for comprehension."

Although the Milky Way dimension is controlled by the Chaos Void, the actual ownership remains with Lin Yuan and other time beings. If one wants to take a new time being in, it is necessary to obtain Lin Yuan’s consent.

"The Milky Way dimension?"

Luo Hou felt slightly excited.

The battle in the Milky Way dimension not long ago, where the Chaos Void’s "Galaxy" repelled the mysterious Second Realm time being "Gray Ancestor," was naturally known to Luo Hou.

"Though the Galaxy became a time being after you, you must not have any conflict with it."

Lord Mo Xu reminded.

"Understood."

Luo Hou, of course, was aware.

Quickly.

Lord Mo Xu took Luo Hou to see Lin Yuan.

"Galaxy." Lord Mo Xu greeted, looking at the young man sitting cross-legged in the void. To Lord Mo Xu, every time line of this young man was vague and led to an endless future.

One by one, these indistinct time lines vaguely led to the same future, leaving Lord Mo Xu in awe.

"Is this the ’Galaxy’? Who just repelled a Second Realm time being not long ago?"

Luo Hou marveled secretly and also wondered why there was such a vast difference between the First Realm and the Second Realm, as even now he felt that a mere glance from Lin Yuan could gravely injure him.

"What’s the matter?"

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and looked at Lord Mo Xu and Luo Hou.

In fact, the moment he saw these two time beings, Lin Yuan knew their purpose.

The future time lines of the two First Realm time beings were clearly visible to Lin Yuan.

"Luo Hou has stabilized his realm; I plan to take him to the Milky Way dimension."

Lord Mo Xu immediately said.

"Oh?"

Lin Yuan nodded, "Comprehending the operation of the Milky Way dimension’s Dao Origin in advance is beneficial for understanding one’s own Origin Dao."

"Thank you, ’Galaxy’."

Luo Hou felt elated; now that he was heading to the Milky Way dimension, it was different from before.

Previously going to the Milky Way dimension meant competing with other time being factions, but now? The entire Milky Way dimension belongs to the Chaos Void, belongs to the Galaxy. Going to the Milky Way dimension now allows one to enjoy the greatest benefits directly.

This was also the reason why Lord Mo Xu came to seek Lin Yuan’s permission.

"No problem."

"You and I both come from the same dimensional space."

Lin Yuan smiled.

He considered himself unable to offer help to time beings from the same dimensional space like the Three-Life Immortal Emperor did.

But as long as it did not affect him, lending a helping hand was possible. The Milky Way dimension now was of no use to Lin Yuan, so allowing Luo Hou to go there to comprehend was merely a simple favor.

Watching Lord Mo Xu and Luo Hou depart.

Lin Yuan once again closed himself off to cultivate.

"Past self?"

Lin Yuan looked towards the past, beginning to have his past self explore against the flow of the time line.

The perfect time beings and countless tribulations in the three transcendent paths all require Lord-level capabilities to attempt.

But the Infinite Origin? With Lin Yuan’s Three-Life techniques, he could explore it in advance.

Exploring the past was not just for the ’Infinite Origin’ transcendent path.

Other time lords’ messages could also be found there.

Now, the future can easily change, bringing variables.

The past, however, is constant, making it the meeting place for time lords’ communications.

Lin Yuan wants to evolve the Origin Clock to a lord-level weapon, undoubtedly needing to trade with other lords.

And the easiest way to meet other lords is to go to a specific time and space in the past.
